integrity: For n at least four, disjoint four-vertex end blocks each carry weight at least four. Equality leaves three local patterns at each end; double Roman constraints at the next internal vertex eliminate all but one pattern on each side, yielding a unique global optimum. The boundary cases are exhaustively checked from the definition.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies minimum restrained double Roman functions, not all feasible functions at higher weights.
The boundary cases H_2 and H_3 are exceptional and are handled by exhaustive finite verification.
Finite verification through n=5 is corroborative for the arbitrary-n theorem.
A differently phrased or non-indexed half-graph result may exist.
title: Minimum restrained double Roman functions of half graphs
